# @bounteous/ui

React component library for the Figma file "shadcn/ui Design System (agent-ready)" (key R1fwFPPMBLnVhMLWumxCkw). Figma property names and values are the React props. Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Radix, shadcn patterns restyled to the Figma tokens.
Read CLAUDE.md first. Token values: tokens/figma-tokens.json. Catalog: `npm run storybook`. Tests: `npm test`.

## Rules
- Use components from the package root before writing markup.
- No hard-coded colors or font sizes. Use token classes: bg-primary text-primary-foreground bg-card text-muted-foreground border-border rounded-lg gap-4 text-sm.
- Dark mode: add class "dark" to an ancestor. Light is the default.
- Hover, focus, active are CSS. Disabled is the `disabled` prop. Invalid/destructive/error is `aria-invalid`.
- Strokes are drawn inside the box (inset-ring), matching Figma sizes.

## Components (Figma -> React)
- Button: Variant->variant (default|outline|secondary|ghost|destructive|link); Size->size (xs 24px|sm 28|default 32|lg 36); Disabled=true->disabled; Label->children; set "Button / Rounded"->rounded
- Input: Invalid=true->aria-invalid; Disabled=true->disabled; Rounded=true->rounded; Value+Text->placeholder or defaultValue. 320x32.
- Field, FieldLabel (required, disabled), FieldDescription (align=left|right)
- Checkbox: Checked (false|true|indeterminate)->checked/defaultChecked/onCheckedChange; Invalid->aria-invalid; Disabled->disabled; Checkbox Field adds label, description. 16px.
- Radio inside RadioGroup: Checked means group value equals Radio value; Invalid->aria-invalid; Disabled->disabled; Radio Field adds label, description.
- Card (size default|sm) with CardImage, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter. 384px wide.
- Avatar (size sm 24|default 32|lg 40; Type fallback|icon|image) with AvatarImage, AvatarFallback, AvatarBadge; AvatarGroup, AvatarGroupCount.
- Figma also has: Accordion, Alert, Alert Dialog, Aspect Ratio, Badge, Breadcrumb, Calendar, Carousel, Chart, Collapsible, Command, Context Menu, Dialog, Drawer, Dropdown Menu, Form, Hover Card, Input OTP, Label, Menubar, Navigation Menu, Pagination, Popover, Progress, Resizable, Scroll Area, Select, Separator, Sheet, Sidebar, Skeleton, Slider, Sonner (Toast), Switch, Table, Tabs, Textarea, Toggle, Toggle Group, Tooltip. No React code for these yet.

## Tokens
Colors (light/dark): background foreground card card-foreground popover popover-foreground primary primary-foreground secondary secondary-foreground muted muted-foreground accent accent-foreground destructive destructive-subtle text-destructive border input ring chart-1..5 sidebar-*.
Radius: xs 2, sm 6, md 8, lg 10, xl 14, 2xl 18, 3xl 22, 4xl 26, full.
Shadows: shadow-2xs, shadow-xs, shadow-sm, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-focus-ring, shadow-destructive-ring.
Text: Tailwind scale in Inter. text-xs 12/16, text-sm 14/20, text-base 16/24, text-lg 18/28, text-xl 20/28; weights font-normal/medium/semibold.
